question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?

WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mc.PID,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, CASE 
            WHEN m.year LIKE 'I %' THEN 3 
            WHEN m.year LIKE 'II %' THEN 4 
            ELSE 1 
        END, 4) AS INTEGER) AS movie_year
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE mc.PID IS NOT NULL
      AND TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, CASE 
            WHEN m.year LIKE 'I %' THEN 3 
            WHEN m.year LIKE 'II %' THEN 4 
            ELSE 1 
        END, 4) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
actor_sorted AS (
    SELECT
        PID,
        movie_year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY movie_year) AS rn
    FROM actor_years
),
actor_gaps AS (
    SELECT
        PID,
        movie_year AS prev_year,
        LEAD(movie_year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY movie_year) AS next_year,
        LEAD(movie_year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY movie_year) - movie_year AS gap
    FROM actor_sorted
),
actor_has_large_gap AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PID
    FROM actor_gaps
    WHERE gap > 4
),
all_actors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM actor_sorted
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_actors
FROM all_actors a
WHERE a.PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM actor_has_large_gap)
